steps.note: Start a valid event creation flow.
Set the potentially unsafe title payload under test.
Configure the event with a pricing template.
Add the required line item for publishing.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event is publishable.
Add the vendor needed to publish and inspect the portal view.
Publish the event containing the HTML payload.
Confirm publication succeeded and the detail page is reached.
Verify the detail page visibly renders the title literally.
Navigate to the events list for the list-view check.
Confirm the events list rendered without an application error.
Verify the published title appears literally in the events list.
Move to the invited vendor's portal.
Open this event in the vendor portal overview.
Verify the vendor portal displays the title literally.
